products.title: Roomspray - Giglio di Firenze - 100ML
products.description_html:
Enclosed in the iconic Dr. Vranjes Firenze diffuser, Giglio di Firenze pays homage to the enchanting and delicate flowers that grow among the Florentine hills. It enhances elegant and intriguing notes of iris, geranium, and patchouli with accords of lavender, bergamot, cardamom, and to finish, a pinch of nutmeg.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Bergamot, Cardamom, Lavender
  • Iris, Geranium, Labdanum
  • Cedarwood, Patchouli, Nutmeg

Giglio di Firenze has a relaxing personality while simultaneously beating like the heart of Florence. Top notes of bergamot and cardamom distinguish the fragrance with lavender, followed by heart notes of iris, geranium, and labdanum, with cedarwood, patchouli, and nutmeg as base notes.

products.title: Roomspray - Aria - 100ML
products.description_html:
The morning dew meets the fresh notes of citrus and mint, which after a while loses the balsamic edge to give a more dry note to this home fragrance. Aria gives freshness and a relaxing feel of wellbeing to living spaces and children's bedrooms.

Olfactory Pyramid:
  • Lemon and Orange Blossom 
  • Wild Mint, Vetiver
  • White Musk, Galbanum

Aria is a relaxation for the soul with fresh and delicate notes of citrus flowers and green and aromatic accords of wild mint, vetiver, white musk, and galbanum.

products.title: Roomspray - Velvet Saffron - 100ML
products.description_html:
The new Home Fragrance Velvet Saffron has a sophisticated and dynamic personality that is warm and welcoming. A precious blend with cardamom notes at the top, saffron in the heart and patchouli in the base.

Olfactory Pyramid

● Cardamom
● Saffron
● Patchouli

Vibrant saffron notes intertwine with violet, vetiver and tonka bean, giving depth and complexity to the fragrance. Cardamom and patchouli dance in perfect harmony, creating a welcoming and elegant atmosphere.

products.title: Spray Tessuto
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Tessuto: Walking through a cotton field, hands open, caressing the fluffy bolls. Touching the lightness of fine silk weaves and natural linens on Lake Como; closing your eyes and breathing in their cool, reassuring texture. Feeling at home, always.

Tessuto:

The coolness of linen and the rustle of silk.
A unique fragrance, created in Como as a tribute to the most precious and natural fibres. Its pervading fragrance is ‘woven’ from bergamot, cassis flowers and cotton leaves, leading to a heart of jasmine and closing with a clean background of white musk.

Room Spray, Cassis Leaves, Cotton Flowers, Jasmine, White Musk

products.title: Roomspray - Rosso Nobile - 100ML
products.description_html:
Rosso Nobile is one of the most unique fragrances in the world. It is the true essence of Tuscany. Let the senses indulge in the aroma of a fine Tuscan red wine made from sublime accords of orange blossom, strawberry, wild berries, oak and birch woods.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Orang, Orange Blossom, Violet
  • Strawberry, Wild Berrie
  • Birch and Oak Wood

The fine and harmonious notes of orange, orange blossom, violet, strawberry, wild berries, birch wood, and oak preserved by Rosso Nobile allude to the barrels of Tuscan red wines celebrated all over the world.

products.title: Roomspray - Ambra - 100ML
products.description_html:
Ambra has a mysterious, sweet, and sensual personality. It will take you on a journey to discover the intense notes of amber, iris blossom, geranium, labdanum and patchouli, and finish with precious woods and Madagascar vanilla. 

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Iris Blossom, Geranium
  • Amber, Cistus, Patchouli, Labdanum
  • Sandalwood, Vanilla, Cedarwood

Ambra immediately creates an enveloping and mysterious aura, with notes of iris and geranium at the top, amber, cistus, patchouli, and labdanum in the heart, and cedar wood, sandalwood, and vanilla at the base.

products.title: KYARA Room Spray 100 ml
products.description_html:
Complexity and Relaxation – A radiant creation of red berries, sweet fennel and Calabrian bergamot that is perfectly balanced by a complex balsamic-sweet bouquet of aromatic guaiac resin, nutmeg, enchanting stephanotis and subtle woody amyris. The sensual base is dominated by woody-spicy notes of amber, labdanum, cedar wood, gurjun balm and earthy patchouli that is accompanied by a powdery-sweet note of musk.

A deep antique green Italian glass flacon with an eye-catching elegant silver wave design, a matt black wooden lid and a black, embossed metal label. The result is a glorious play of the black and white colouring.

products.title: SOGNO Room Spray 100 ml
products.description_html:
Softness and Temptation - A smooth balsamic composition of spicy ginger and exotic elemi with a citric nuance that is surrounded by gentle accents of olibanum and amber, an incomparable infatuating scent experience. Perfumer: MARK BUXTON

SOGNO comes in a gleaming gratuated gold-coloured flacon out of Italian glass and an innovative multiplex lid with alternate light and dark wooden veneers.

products.title: Talvolta - Room Spray Soli - Reperti Immagi - 100ml
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Talvolta Room Spray Reperti - Immaginazione by Fornasetti is a spicy room spray, with a design that reflects the timeless elegance of neoclassicism. The scent Immaginazione is a powerful, yet elegant fragrance. A combination of Mediterranean herbs from Casa Fornasetti's garden and cedar and sandalwood offers complexity to the space where the spray is misted.


Fragrance notes

Top: lavender, thyme, juniper, geranium
Heart: cedarwood, patchouli, vanilla
Base: amber, oakmoss, tonka beans, oud wood, sandalwood


DETAILS

Made Of 24,79% Glass, 13,77% Liquid, 6,20% Cap (zamak + Plastic) + 1,38% Pump + 53,86% Porcelain

products.title: Talvolta Room Spray - Bocche F Proibito - 100ml
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
The Talvolta Room Spray Bocche - Frutto Proibito by Fornasetti is a sophisticated room spray that echoes the lips of Fornasetti icon Lina Cavalieri. The seductive fragrance Frutto Proibito excites the senses with Mediterranean and citrus top notes, jasmine, tuberose and sweet rosewood. In Fornasetti products, design and fragrance merge into a timeless, sensory experience. Variations may be visible as each creation is handcrafted and each one is unique. Mist the spray and be enveloped by the olfactory fragrance experience of Frutto Proibito.

Fragrance notes

Top: aniseed, bergamot, blood orange, grapefruit from Sicily
Heart: jasmine, tuberose from Mexico, ylang-ylang, cyclamen
Base: vanilla, oakmoss, cedar from Cuba, rosewood

DETAILS

Made Of 24,79% Glass, 13,77% Liquid, 6,20% Cap (zamak + Plastic) + 1,38% Pump + 53,86% Porcelain

products.title: Roomspray - Calvado's - 100ML
products.description_html:
Calvado's has a warm and enveloping character composed of apple, bergamot, coriander, saffron, sandalwood and cedarwood. This iconic diffuser recalls memories of soft lighting, a fireplace, and leather armchairs on which to enjoy a handcrafted drink.
Olfactory Pyramid:
  • Bergamot, Coriander
  • Apple, Galbanum
  • Cedarwood, Sandalwood

Calvado's envelops you with notes of fresh fruit expertly warmed by coriander, galbanum, and precious woods to create a sophisticated and relaxing aroma.

products.title: Roomspray - Peonia Black Jasmine - 100ML
products.description_html:
Peonia Black Jasmine is a multifaceted floral fragrance, including peony, ylang ylang, and black jasmine, enclosed in the elegant diffuser to represent the vitality and cheerfulness of every woman.
Olfactory Pyramid:
  • Hyacinth, Lily of the Valley, Orange Blossom
  • Black Jasmine, Peony, Cyclamen
  • Cloves, Musk, Ylang Ylang

Peonia Black Jasmine has a floral and sparkling personality. Be seduced by the nuances of orange blossom, hyacinth, lily of the valley, black jasmine, peony, cyclamen, cloves, musk, and ylang ylang.

products.title: Roomspray - Melograno - 100ML
products.description_html:
Vibrant and full of surprises, Melograno by Dr. Vranjes Firenze is unlike any other fragrance. Melograno is a tribute to an original and personal link between watermelon, bergamot, cassis, and red grapes.

Olfactory Pyramid:
  • Watermelon
  • Jasmine, Rose, Bergamot 
  • Cassis, Red Grapes 

Watermelon essence introduces the fragrance, followed by notes of rose, jasmine, bergamot, cassis, and red grapes. Fruity and a little tart, Melograno is the home fragrance for lovers of fresh and lively elegance.

products.title: Roomspray - Arancio Uva Rossa - 100ML
products.description_html:
Always fresh and inviting in character, Arancio Uva Rossa is a tribute to the Tuscan grape harvest. This fragrance will welcome you by warming the senses, thanks to the harmonious combination of bitter orange, red grapes, cinnamon, and violet.

Olfactory Pyramid:
  • Bitter Orange, Mandarin
  • Red Grape, Rose, Magnolia 
  • Violet, Cinnamon, Birch Wood

A fresh and pleasant story where bitter orange and mandarin meet red grapes, roses, magnolia, violet, cinnamon, and birch wood, to give life to a tasty surprise waiting to be discovered.

products.title: Roomspray - Bellini - 100ML
products.description_html:
Fresh as an aperitif, sparkling like the water of Venice under the sun, the Bellini fragrance offers an olfactory dance between bergamot and peach, white grape and lily of the valley, vetiver and ginger, culminating in a vivid and unforgettable experience.
Olfactory Pyramid
  • Bergamot, Lily of the Valley, White Grape
  • Peach
  • Litsea Cubeba, Vetiver, Ginger

Top notes of bergamot, lily of the valley, and white grapes, followed by a heart of peach and a base of litsea cubeba, vetiver, and ginger. The Bellini fragrance is the ultimate expression of Venetian charm, the scent of peaches, and important promises.

products.title: Roomspray - Oud Nobile - 100ML
products.description_html:
With its singular and precious character, Oud Nobile is a fragrance that conquers little by little. The oud, skilfully combined with notes of neroli and bergamot, incense and myrrh, amber, and sandalwood, seduces your senses and thrills them. Experience the allure and rarity of "liquid gold" in an unparalleled olfactory blend.
Olfactory Pyramid:
  • Bergamot, Neroli 
  • Oud, Myrrh, Frankincense, Amber, Sandalwood
  • Guajaco Wood, Musk, Nagarmotha

Oud Nobile has a precious personality with neroli and bergamot at the top, oud, myrrh, incense, amber, and sandalwood at the heart, with musk and precious woods at the base.

products.title: Roomspray - Albero di Natale - 100ML
products.description_html:
The exclusive Albero di Natale fragrance warms and fills the heart and home with joy. Notes of star anise, chlorophyll, pine wood and resin, wild mint, and underbrush mosses combine to capture the magic of the holidays in a memorable and evocative fragrance for the whole year.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Star Anise, Chlorophyll, Basil
  • Rosemary, Pine Wood, Wild Mint
  • Underbrush Mosses, Pine Resin

The magic of the holidays is enclosed here in a fragrance with aromatic notes. Featuring star anise, chlorophyll, and basil at the top, rosemary, pine wood, and wild mint in the heart, with underbrush moss and pine resin at the bottom.

products.title: Roomspray - Limone Cedrato - 100ML
products.description_html:
Radiant and evergreen, the new room fragrance Limone Cedrato transports with its aura of vitality and harmony to the lush gardens of the Medici family in Florence. An emblem of beauty and prosperity, it is ideal for those seeking a clean, crisp, yet harmonious atmosphere. It transforms any environment into a place of positivity and joy.

Olfactory Pyramid
    • Florence Cedar, Bergamot.
    • Citrus Leaves, Lemon Blossom/Citrus Flowers
    • Vetiver, Sandalwood
       

    The sunny opening of Florence Cedar and Bergamot ignites the senses with an intense and refined freshness. The citrus and floral heart, enriched with citrus leaves and lemon blossom, gives a sense of purity and naturalness. The warm base of Vetiver and Sandalwood adds depth and persistence for a rejuvenating olfactory experience.

products.title: Spray Thé
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. The: Soaking in the meditative warmth of a bath tub filled with Japanese green tea. Vapours rise hypnotically off the water, delicately diffusing and filling the room with the aroma of tea leaves.

Thé:

The tea ceremony, slow and meditative. Hypnotic gestures of an ancient tradition performed one by one in a symbolic ritual. A balanced and pure blend of bergamot and Japanese green Sencha tea, complemented by a note of guaiacum wood.
A tribute to slowness.

Room Spray, Bergamot, Sencha Tea, Guaiacum Wood

products.title: Spray Supreme Amber
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Supreme Amber: a soft sunset at the end of September in the middle of a park, when the summer slowly fades into autumn. The warm atmosphere made sparkling by a fresh breeze.

Quercea:

Supreme Amber tells the atmosphere of a soft sunset in the end of September: imagine a walk in a park lit by warm colors, the air sparkling announcing the arrival of a new season. Supreme Amber is the invitation to live a passing moment in all its complex essence; to enter into an unexpected change with determination and sweet abandonment.

The warm and intense background of incense and patchouli is softened by the precious black vanilla and made fresh by the lively opening of cyst and chinotto: a complex and deeply rich fragrance, perfect to tell the thousand facets of a magic moment.

Room Spray, Incense, Chinot,To Black Vanilla,  Patchouli

products.title: Spray Quercea 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance.  Representing the power of nature, Quercea reproduces the extraordinary strength of an eternal tree that breathes in the wild essence of the forest and takes the energy out of it.

Quercea:

Representing the power of nature. Quercea reproduces the extraordinary strength of an eternal tree that breathes in the wild essence of the forest and takes the energy out of it.

Room Spray, Red Fruits, Jasmine, Lasdanum, Honey

products.title: Spray Ode Rosae 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Ode Rosae: Paying homage to the nobility of the rose, the queen of the garden; bowing down to touch the untamed power of her wood, letting her stirring delicacy go to your head. A flower for men.

Ode Rosae:

The sensual, scented nights of Marrakech. An ancient soul of Moroccan rose, strong, heady and wild, penetrates the senses and loses itself in an olfactory labyrinth that winds its way through gardens carrying cassis and osmanthus with a green note of vetiver.
For those who wish to lose – or find – themselves.

Room Spray, Cassis, Osmanthus, Moroccan Rose, Vetiver, Tonka Bean

products.title: Spray Mountain 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Mountain: The cosy atmosphere of a mountain chalet, with the warm logs in the fireplace giving off their delicate, slightly balsamic, almost oriental aroma.

Mountain:

Step by step, from the dense undergrowth of distant forests the air gradually becomes rarefied, with occasional pungent scents of cardamom, cedar and labdanum emerging in all their intensity.
For explorers.

Room Spray, Citron Leaves, Cardamom, Guaiacum, Vetiver, Cedar Wood, Labdanum

products.title: Spray Mediterranea 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Mediterranea: The Apulian countryside in all of its fertile abundance, with pomegranate trees and prickly pears laden with fruits peeking above the drystone walls. Wandering into the Mediterranean scrub overlooking the sea; picking fruit, getting your hands dirty, tasting its woody essence.

Mediterranea:

Immerse yourself in the tangy scents of the Mediterranean and experience the sensation of a deeper breath.
Fresh, with a spicy note of ginger and an elegant touch of cedar wood.
For those who are attentive to detail.

Room Spray, Bitter Orange, Lemon, Neroli, Ginger, Lentisk, Cedar Wood

products.title: Spray Mareminerale 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Mareminerale: The sun rises above the sea: footsteps land softly on the shore, absorbing the pungent energy of iodine and the damp smell of driftwood smoothed by the rocking of the waves. The vigour of a dawn walk along the water’s edge.

Mareminerale:

Capture all the stimulating and oxygenating energy of the sea, diving headlong into the foam of its waves. Breathe, bathe, collect shells and driftwood as you stroll leisurely along the shore.
Well-being in its purest state.

Room Spray, Sea Accord, Sap, Mineral Musk

products.title: Spray Linfa 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Linfa: Rediscovering oneself while strolling through woodland, that slopes down to the sea. A stimulating blend of subtlety and potency, from tiny lustrous berries and white blossoms, to the serene majesty of the sea and mountains.

Linfa:

Iridescent, transparent and vital. Pure and strong, light and tenacious.
An encounter between white currant and tuberose, fading into cedar wood.

Room Spray, Rhubarbarb, Centifolia Rose, Patchouli

products.title: Spray Gratia 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Gratia: a tribute to Spring and it represents an intense moment of inner peace.

Gratia:

A quiet walk in a centuries-old rose garden during a warm May afternoon. Blooming roses all around for a relaxing blissful moment.

Room Spray, Rhubarbarb, Centifolia Rose, Patchouli

products.title: Spray Ficum Blu 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with a bronze serigraphy. Ficum Blu: a summer afternoon of our childhood: an afternoon snack of freshly picked juicy figs, after a long bicycle ride in the sun-parched countryside.

Ficum Blu:

Ficum Blu is a celebration of the Italian lifestyle, represented as a basket brimming with ripe fruit: resting on a structured ground of patchouli lie the citrusy notes of Italian lemon and mandarin oranges, together with the sweetest heart of fig, whose softness is enhanced by notes of jasmine.

Room Spray, Lemon, Mandarin, Fig, Jasmine, Patchouli

products.title: Spray Era 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Era: an enchanted place that reminds of a time, an era, unforgettable. Vegetable luxury.

Era:

The sweet sour feel of forest comes from an experience of meditative, enveloping and theatrical breath.
A rough and sweet place at the same time shaded.
Truthful, in total harmony with the soul and with the place of reference.
An enchanted place that reminds of a time, an era, unforgettable.

Room Spray, Cassis, Blueberry, Rose, Vegetable Amber, Cedar Wood

products.title: Spray Damasque 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with a bronze serigraphy. Damasque: A heavy cloak of fine damask, regal and precious. A noble and finely worked fabric, to be appreciated in all its textures.

Damasque:

Damasque is sophisticated and shiny as an elegant damask cape: the intense background of cedar wood and patchouli is interwoven with the sweetness of the rose damask and the intensity of the opoponax, while the spicy notes in the head of Ginger and black pepper create shiny reflections, like a gold embroidery.

Room Spray, Ginger, Black Pepper, Opoponax, Cedarwood, Patchouli

products.title: Roomspray - Giardino di Boboli - 100ML
products.description_html:
Giardino di Boboli is a fragrance with a noble soul. It encompasses notes of citrus blossoms mixed with roses, jasmine and green moss. At the base, the diffuser crowns its aromatic personality with galbanum, wild spearmint and cypress wood.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Lemon and Orange Blossom 
  • Rose, Green Moss, Jasmine
  • Galbanum, Wild Pennyroyal, Cypress Wood

Lemon and orange blossoms at the top, rose, green moss, and jasmine at the fragrance's heart, and galbanum, wild mint, and cypress wood at the base. This fragrance captures the wonder and scents one experiences by getting lost in the Boboli Gardens.

products.title: Roomspray - Acqua - 100ML
products.description_html:
The Acqua diffuser has a delicate and marine soul. Let yourself be carried away by its freshness to a place of harmony, thanks to the top notes of basil, the waves of the sea in the heart, and white musk in the base, which completes the olfactory experience.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Basil, Myrtle 
  • Marine Notes, Seaweed
  • White Musk, Cedarwood

Aqua has a relaxing personality, characterized by top notes of myrtle and basil, followed by a heart of seaweed and base notes of white musk and cedar wood.

products.title: Roomspray - Rosa Tabacco - 100ML
products.description_html:
The Rosa Tabacco fragrance is an unexpected encounter. Elegant and delicate like a rose, warm and bold like tobacco, Rosa Tabacco by Dr. Vranjes Firenze is a surprising and extravagant olfactory experience.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Violet, Orange
  • Rose, Tobacco, Amber
  • Vanilla, Musk, Sandalwood 

Rosa Tabacco has a warm and sensual personality. Featuring notes of violet and orange in the top, with rose, tobacco, and amber in the heart, and finally vanilla, musk, and sandalwood in the base.

products.title: Roomspray - Green Flowers - 100ML
products.description_html:
Breathing in the Green Flowers fragrance by Dr. Vranjes Firenze will envelop you in a wave of spring freshness thanks to the notes of tea flowers, Italian citrus fruits, ylang ylang, jasmine, vetiver, and wild mint.


Olfactory Pyramid
  • Tea Flowers, Lemon, Neroli
  • Ylang Ylang, Jasmine
  • Vetiver, Wild Mint

Green Flowers will refresh you with a bouquet of green flowers thanks to accords of tea flowers, lemon, neroli, ylang ylang, jasmine, vetiver, and wild mint.

products.title: Roomspray - Milano - 100ML
products.description_html:
The Milano fragrance, enclosed in the elegant Dr. Vranjes Firenze diffuser, has a personality as sophisticated as the city. Notes of orange blossom and cypress, sandalwood and patchouli capture the energetic, always on-the-go vibes for which Milan is famous.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Orange Blossom, Cardamom
  • Cedar, Pepper, Cypress, Amber
  • Patchouli, Sandalwood

With the top notes of orange blossom and cardamom, followed by the heart notes of cedar, pepper, amber, and cypress, and the base notes of patchouli and sandalwood, all the charm of Milano is captured to represent the unique and always dynamic attitude of the metropolis.

products.title: Roomspray - Leather Oud - 100ML
products.description_html:
The new Leather Oud Home Fragrance has an intense and lush, exotic and enveloping personality. 
A precious, intense and bold blend with notes of rose and geranium at the top, Tuscan leather and Middle Eastern oud in the heart, and sandalwood, musk and vanilla at the base.

Olfactory Pyramid

  • Elemi, Geranium, Rose, Lily of the valley
  • Oud, Leather, Incense, Patchouli, Amber
  • Ebony wood, Sandalwood, Musk, Vanilla

A sublime and rich combination of elemi, geranium, rose and lily of the valley in the top, oud, leather, incense, patchouili, amber in the heart and ebony wood, sandalwood, musk and vanilla in the base

products.title: Roomspray - Petali di Rose - 100ML
products.description_html:
Dr. Vranjes Firenze Petali di Rose fragrance is a seductive tribute to three precious roses (May rose, Bulgarian and Turkish). With notes of amber, jasmine, and white musk, Petali di Rose is a scent that enhances the charm and elegance of those who choose it.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Violet, Ylang Ylang
  • Rose, Amber
  • Vanilla, White Musk

Petali di Rose has an elegant and multifaceted personality composed of top notes of violet and ylang ylang, followed by a heart of rose and amber, with a base of vanilla and white musk.

products.title: Roomspray - Magnolia Orchidea - 100ML
products.description_html:
Magnolia Orchidea is a sweet floral symphony for the senses: a blend of sweet magnolia and orchid flowers enhanced by a touch of neroli, mimosa, lily of the valley, ylang ylang and ivy. This iconic diffuser will tell a story that begins with a single orchid.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Magnolia, Orchid, Mimosa, Lily of the Valley
  • Crystallized Orange, Neroli 
  • Ylang Ylang, Ivy 

Magnolia flowers, orchids, mimosa and lily of the valley, splendid accords of crystallized orange and neroli, and base notes of ylang ylang and ivy will lull you into a fragrant relaxation.

products.title: Roomspray - Mirra Zaferano - 100ML
products.description_html:
The Mirra Zafferano fragrance by Dr. Vranjes Firenze will add a sophisticated, sweet, and gourmet touch to your day, thanks to the notes of bergamot, myrrh, and amber, infused with saffron, incense, and vanilla.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Elemi, Bergamot
  • Myrrh, Frankincense, Amber
  • Vanilla, Saffron

Mirra Zafferano has a pleasant and enveloping personality with top notes of elemi and bergamot, followed by a heart of myrrh, incense, amber, with a base of vanilla and saffron.

products.title: Roomspray - Chinotto Pepe - 100ML
products.description_html:
Chinotto Pepe is a fragrance that attracts attention. Bergamot, chinotto, mandarin, and orange meet and collide with vetiver, sandalwood, saffron, and pepper to give vibrancy and vitality.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Bergamot, Mandarin, Orange
  • Chinotto, Cardamom, Saffron
  • Vetiver, Sandalwood, Black Pepper

Chinotto Pepe comes from the radiance of the Chinotto, from its unmistakable scent, mixed with the strength of black pepper and other incredible ingredients: bergamot, mandarin, orange, cardamom, saffron, vetiver, and sandalwood.

products.title: Roomspray - Vaniglia Mandarino - 100ML
products.description_html:
Sweet and playful, the Vaniglia Mandarino fragrance leaves a pleasant trail composed of the unmistakable accords of vanilla, mandarin, and a pinch of tonka bean. For those who experience it, this Dr. Vranjes Firenze fragrance will awaken the desire to go back in time to one's childhood.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Mandarin 
  • Vanilla
  • Tonka Bean

Allow yourself to feel joy and choose to lose yourself among the fresh and sweet notes of mandarin, vanilla, and tonka bean.

products.title: Roomspray - Ginger Lime - 100ML
products.description_html:
An ambient fragrance with a radiant character, where the fresh citrus notes of lime meet the spicy and energising ginger. Ginger Lime is a concentrated freshness, perfect to adorn living spaces with a welcoming and sparkling atmosphere.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Lime, Lemon 
  • Ginger, Vetiver
  • White pepper, Ebony Wood, and Guajac 

Ginger Lime has a radiant personality, characterized by top notes of lime and lemon, followed by a heart of ginger and vetiver, and base notes of white pepper and refined woods.

products.title: Roomspray - Terra - 100ML
products.description_html:
The Terra fragrance by Dr. Vranjes Firenze was created to celebrate the beauty of our planet. It will take you on a pleasant walk with its notes of white musk, vetiver, Siberian pine, and wild mint.

Olfactory Pyramid
  • Lavender
  • Siberian Pine, Wild Mint, Vetiver 
  • Green Moss, Vanilla 

The Earth's energy comes to life in this fragrance, thanks to its aromatic notes with a regenerating effect: lavender, Siberian pine, wild mint, vetiver, green musk, and vanilla.

products.title: Spray Aramara 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Aramara is the result of an afternoon spent in the kitchen of a Sicilian pastry chef who summoned his skills to reveal the countless secrets of bitter orange.

Aramara:

Aramara is the result of an afternoon spent in the kitchen of a Sicilian pastry chef who summoned his skills to reveal the countless secrets of bitter orange. Formulated like a product of haute patisserie, Aramara is a gourmand fragrance.

Room Spray, Bitter Orange, Bergamot, Sandalwood.

products.title: Spray Aqqua 100ML
products.description_html:
Exclusive sculpted, square-shaped bottle in clear glass with different coloured serigraphy for each fragrance. Aqqua: A wide-open sea view, one glance sweeping across the bay, the mountain sliding into the deep blue, and the villages perched up high, resembling a painting. A place of natural elegance with a vigorous, almost physical energy.

Aqqua:

A burst of positive, invigorating energy to fuel your dreams of freedom.
Fresh, bold, almost masculine, evoking open spaces.
Citrus scents blended with spices and aromatic herbs are complemented by amber and fragrant woody notes. Carrying you far away.

Room Spray, Coriander, Bergamot, Mimose, Sage, Sandal Wood
